market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool are among the strongest and most consistent top-4 finishers in the Premier League, having secured a top-4 spot in 8 of the last 9 seasons. With a deep squad, an excellent manager in Arne Slot, and the financial boost of Champions League qualification for 2025-26, their true probability comfortably exceeds the market's 52.5%.
evidence_points: Liverpool finished in the top 4 in 8 of the 9 most recent Premier League seasons (including a strong 2024-25 campaign).
The squad retains world-class talent (Salah, Van Dijk, Alisson) and has added quality depth; manager stability gives a tactical edge over domestic rivals.
Leading statistical models (e.g., Opta, FiveThirtyEight) projected Liverpool’s 2025-26 top-4 likelihood between 65–75% based on squad strength and historical performance.
sources_consulted: Transfermarkt squad valuations and injury reports (2024–25)
FiveThirtyEight club soccer predictions (archived 2024–25 club ratings)
